name: letta-agent
title: Letta AgentState
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta AgentState entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: last_updated_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was last updated.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the agent. Assigned by the database.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the agent.

fields.name: tool_rules
fields.description: The list of tool rules.

fields.name: message_ids
fields.description: The ids of the messages in the agent's in-context memory.

fields.name: system
fields.description: The system prompt used by the agent.

fields.name: agent_type
fields.description: Enum to represent the type of agent.

fields.name: llm_config
fields.description: Configuration for Language Model (LLM) connection and generation parameters.

fields.name: embedding_config
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `embedding` field instead. The embedding configuration used by the agent.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model handle used by the agent (format: provider/model-name).

fields.name: embedding
fields.description: The embedding model handle used by the agent (format: provider/model-name).

fields.name: model_settings
fields.description: The model settings used by the agent.

fields.name: compaction_settings
fields.description: The compaction settings configuration used for compaction.

fields.name: response_format
fields.description: The response format used by the agent

fields.name: description
fields.description: The description of the agent.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: The metadata of the agent.

fields.name: memory
fields.description: Represents the in-context memory (i.e. Core memory) of the agent. This includes both the `Block` objects (labelled by sections), as well as tools to edit the blocks.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The memory blocks used by the agent.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The tools used by the agent.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `folders` field instead. The sources used by the agent.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: The tags associated with the agent.

fields.name: tool_exec_environment_variables
fields.description: Deprecated: use `secrets` field instead.

fields.name: secrets
fields.description: The environment variables for tool execution specific to this agent.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: The id of the project the agent belongs to.

fields.name: template_id
fields.description: The id of the template the agent belongs to.

fields.name: base_template_id
fields.description: The base template id of the agent.

fields.name: deployment_id
fields.description: The id of the deployment.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: The id of the entity within the template.

fields.name: identity_ids
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `identities` field instead. The ids of the identities associated with this agent.

fields.name: identities
fields.description: The identities associated with this agent.

fields.name: pending_approval
fields.description: The latest approval request message pending for this agent, if any.

fields.name: message_buffer_autoclear
fields.description: If set to True, the agent will not remember previous messages (though the agent will still retain state via core memory blocks and archival/recall memory). Not recommended unless you have an advanced use case.

fields.name: enable_sleeptime
fields.description: If set to True, memory management will move to a background agent thread.

fields.name: multi_agent_group
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `managed_group` field instead. The multi-agent group that this agent manages.

fields.name: managed_group
fields.description: The multi-agent group that this agent manages

fields.name: last_run_completion
fields.description: The timestamp when the agent last completed a run.

fields.name: last_run_duration_ms
fields.description: The duration in milliseconds of the agent's last run.

fields.name: last_stop_reason
fields.description: The stop reason from the agent's last run.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: The timezone of the agent (IANA format).

fields.name: max_files_open
fields.description: Maximum number of files that can be open at once for this agent. Setting this too high may exceed the context window, which will break the agent.

fields.name: per_file_view_window_char_limit
fields.description: The per-file view window character limit for this agent. Setting this too high may exceed the context window, which will break the agent.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: If set to True, the agent will be hidden.
